tasks.title: Foundation: Data Contract (Sheet/Feed + DB Schema)
tasks.description: Define and document stable Sheet/feed tabs, DB import fields, sync_log, audit_log, account config, and guardrail JSON that every downstream feature depends on. Must cover ALL datasets consumed by later tasks (PMax, geo, placements, budget pacing, Voluum true-profit). No UI, no writes enabled.
tasks.details: Owned by Agent A. Lock tab names and columns. Core raw tabs: raw_campaign_daily, raw_adgroup_daily, raw_keyword_daily, raw_search_term_daily, raw_hour_device, raw_policy. Extended raw tabs required by later tasks: raw_pmax_channel_daily, raw_pmax_terms_daily, raw_geo_daily, raw_placement_daily, raw_budget_daily, raw_conversion_action_daily, and a Voluum revenue/profit source (raw_voluum_revenue). Analysis tabs: analysis_campaign, analysis_keyword, analysis_search_terms, analysis_pmax, analysis_geo, analysis_placement, analysis_budget_pacing, analysis_profit. Control tabs: index, config, proposal_queue, sync_log, audit_log. Rules: dates YYYY-MM-DD; numeric metrics with no currency symbols; derived metrics computed from core metrics (not averaged from averages); stable IDs campaign_id/ad_group_id/criterion_id (+ geo/placement keys where relevant); identical headers every run. Provide migration notes and sample rows. Publish ALL field names early (including PMax/geo/placement/budget/Voluum) so no downstream agent has to guess schema.
tasks.testStrategy: Contract/validator tests for every tab's names, headers, and types (including PMax/geo/placement/budget/Voluum). Import/export roundtrip on sample data. Schema migration dry-run. Verify no write/mutate path is enabled.

tasks.title: Remote Campaign Updates: Proposal Queue, Feed, Guardrails & Audit
tasks.description: Proposal queue UI and safe execution model where the dashboard prepares campaign updates but only the in-account Google Ads Script applies them via a token-guarded feed. v1 apply scope is limited to SET_BUDGET, PAUSE_CAMPAIGN, ENABLE_CAMPAIGN, SET_CAMPAIGN_LABEL. Includes guardrails, dry-run, audit states, rollback, and kill switch.
tasks.details: Owned by Agent G. Flow: dashboard creates proposal -> approve/queue -> server writes token-guarded feed row -> in-account script polls -> re-checks live state -> apply/skip -> posts result to bid_action_log. Supported v1 APPLY actions: SET_BUDGET, PAUSE_CAMPAIGN, ENABLE_CAMPAIGN, SET_CAMPAIGN_LABEL. Explicitly OUT of v1 apply scope (proposal-first / later phase only): SET_BID_STRATEGY_TARGET, negative-keyword application, bid changes, schedule/device/geo modifiers. Candidates from Task 5 (negative-keyword/bid) are review/export-only and must NOT be written to this apply feed in v1. Not allowed v1: create campaigns/ads, broad keywords, auto-apply Google recs, change conversion tracking, billing, update without stable campaign_id, shared budgets unless allow_shared_budget. UI: queue with action, old->new, reason, risk, guardrail result, expiry, approval status, result; dry-run preview; per-action rollback; Copy Debug Packet; global kill switch in header. Guardrails (server + script): review_only default, allowlist required, denylist wins, max budget change %, max actions/campaign/day, max total budget delta/day, stale data fails closed, optimistic concurrency skip on drift. States: ready, approved, dry_run, applied, skipped_stale_data, skipped_guardrail, skipped_campaign_changed, skipped_shared_budget, skipped_not_allowlisted, skipped_denylisted, not_found, failed, rolled_back. NO Google OAuth/API in BitMonitor; no browser/backend mutation of Google Ads.
tasks.testStrategy: Full dry-run-to-apply simulation; guardrail fail-closed tests; concurrency drift skip test; audit completeness; verify only the 4 v1 actions can be applied and bid/negative actions are rejected from apply; verify no OAuth/API path and kill switch blocks all updates even with feed rows.
